Thanks Monica — pulling items together now. Summary of what we can include and wording suggestions for the attestation: 

1) Scan cadence and scope (what we will state):
- Authenticated host network & container vulnerability scans: weekly for production asset tags.
- Image baseline scanning (CI/CD): every build + pre-deploy policy gates.
- External perimeter scanning: bi-weekly.
- Rapid ad-hoc scans triggered on high-severity alerts or major changes.

2) CVE triage + remediation windows (operational practice):
- Critical (CVSS >= 9.0 or actively exploited): initial triage within 4 hours; mitigation/fix or documented compensating control within 72 hours where practical.
- High (CVSS 7.0–8.9): triage within 24 hours; mitigation plan within 7 calendar days, remediation per release cadence (hotfix or next patch window).
- Medium/Low: triage and schedule per priority (30/90 day windows depending on exposure).

Notes: For some third-party managed services / vendor-provided images we operate an exception process — we will clearly call out any assets with different SLAs in the manifest.

3) Retention:
- Raw scan outputs and historical indexes retained for 24 months.
- Aggregated monthly remediation summaries retained indefinitely in the evidence archive.

4) Evidence we will attach to the packet (preliminary list):
- weekly-scan-index-2028-Q3.csv (index with timestamps + scopes)
- cve-remediation-summary-202808.pdf (monthly remediation summary)
- cve-commitment-letter-signed.pdf (one-page attestation, signed by Monica)
- redwood-vm-evidence-packet-2028-09-12.zip (zip with a redacted ticket example and raw scan output excerpts)

5) Owners / contacts:
- Mateo Alvarez (Vuln Ops) — contact for raw logs and ticket exports.
- Kimberly Park — security verification and attestation wording.

I'll drop the artifacts to the Drive by 12:00pm PT today and will follow up with the signed attestation. If we need legal sign-off on wording, flag now; otherwise Monica can sign.

-Kim
